notes.title: BIG UPDATE FOR JEFF-16 !
notes.notes:
jEFF-16 was updated !

We listened to some feedback from our testers and we improved a few things;

1. BOOST BUTTON ! - Left Shift.
2. The game is now more accessible to people who can't go through or touch all the yellow hoops. There is now a bigger green hoop around the yellow one that counts as passing the checkpoint.
3. Out of bounds mechanic - You can no longer wonder around and get lost :)
4. Prettier and more aesthetic menu.
5. Adjusted controls - The plane rotates little faster.
6. Inverted controls on CAPS-LOCK.
7. We added a COMBO mechanic that shows how many times you went through the yellow hoop perfectly.
8. More satisfying animations for passing hoops.

Hope you like it ! <3

KAP-GAMES.
